digest.component_or_area: mypy strictness ratchet and type system
propositions: mypy's `disallow_untyped_defs` permits `: Any` return annotations and therefore does not constrain explicit `Any` usage repo-wide
37 untyped function definitions across 12 packages require annotation to achieve baseline strictness without introducing new `Any` types
14 packages can be promoted to the `disallow_untyped_defs` ratchet tier in `pyproject.toml` once their untyped definitions are annotated
two-tier ratchet mechanism is required: tier 1 for untyped definitions and tier 2 for explicit `Any` usage, governed separately in `tool.mypy.overrides`
test_mypy_ratchet.py must enforce both tiers as shrink-only, preventing packages from being removed from either ratchet list
three large packages (llm, _commands, _engine with 573 untyped defs) contain the residue too large for this ticket's scope and must be split into follow-up tickets
